evals.prompt: Scrape the X/Twitter profile for the handle openai.
evals.expected_output: The skill runs the SELAT-native twitter user-info step and returns the profile JSON (bio, follower counts).
assertions: The skill triggers (scrapecreators) for a social profile scrape request
The step rail is x402 via Circle Gateway (no SELAT Router)

evals.prompt: Show me what's trending on TikTok.
evals.expected_output: The MPP-on-Tempo StableSocial tiktok/search step runs with query=trending (keyword-search proxy; there is no trending-feed endpoint) and returns matching videos.
assertions: The skill triggers for a trending-content request
The step URL is https://stablesocial.dev/api/tiktok/search with body {"query":"trending"}
The step is rail via the SELAT Router (MPP via the SELAT Router)

evals.prompt: Pull the LinkedIn company page data for https://linkedin.com/company/anthropic.
evals.expected_output: The MPP-on-Tempo Scrape Creators LinkedIn company step runs with the supplied company URL and returns the company page data.
assertions: The linkedinCompanyUrl param flows into the Scrape Creators company step as the url query parameter
The step method is GET and rail via the SELAT Router

evals.prompt: Get the recent Instagram posts for the handle openai.
evals.expected_output: The MPP-on-Tempo StableSocial instagram/posts step runs with the handle and returns the recent posts JSON (there is no single-post-by-URL endpoint).
assertions: The handle param flows into the instagram/posts step body
The step method is POST and rail via the SELAT Router

evals.prompt: Run the full scrapecreators skill with defaults.
evals.expected_output: All 12 steps run — 3 x402-via-Circle-Gateway SELAT-native steps plus 9 MPP-on-Tempo StableSocial/Scrape Creators steps — and the run cost is capped at the manifest maxAmount.
assertions: SELAT-native Twitter steps use catalog.selat.ai; StableSocial and Scrape Creators LinkedIn steps settle via the SELAT Router

evals.prompt: What's the weather forecast for Lisbon this weekend?
evals.expected_output: The scrapecreators skill does NOT trigger; this is unrelated to social media scraping.
assertions: The scrapecreators skill is not selected
No SELAT-native, StableSocial, or Scrape Creators social-scraping endpoint is called
